sections.Profile:
Choose one of the Five Families and lead it to rule New York City, taking on jobs, acquiring territories and taking out rival families in this licensed game based on The Godfather films. Designed by Eric Meunier, it features a rotating Caporegime bash toy and a soundtrack with Slash and Mark Tremonti performing "Speak Softly Love".

- Manufacturer: Jersey Jack Pinball
- Years made: 2023
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: LCD
- Players: 4
- Tags: 2020s, Licensed, Solid State, Drama, Gangster, Crime
